issue.detail: Spec says output remains 1 until reset; contract R2 uses out<=out|fall (sticky) which matches, but R1 visible same_cycle vs R2 next_cycle creates ambiguity on reset-release cycle when a falling edge coincides.
issue.spec_evidence: the output will remain 1 until the register is reset (active high synchronous reset)
issue.alternative: On the first posedge with reset==0, if prev_in&~in is nonzero, capture the falling edge (out=fall) rather than clearing to 0.
